name: SessionResource
description:
SessionResource is one thing a conversation holds: a File the agent finds
 in its uploads folder, a git repository cloned into its workspace, or a
 folder on the person's own machine.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The directory a repository or a local folder is given in the
 workspace: unique among the conversation's repositories and folders.
 Empty for a file, which is placed by its mount_path.

fields.name: File
fields.description: A File the agent finds under .stigmer/uploads/.

fields.name: GitRepository
fields.description: A git repository cloned into the workspace.

fields.name: LocalPath
fields.description: A folder on the person's own machine, used where it is.
